items.title: Barrow Appeals for URR Votes, Pledges 360 Kilometers of Roads After Election
items.summary: By Makutu Manneh President Adama Barrow has urged residents of the Upper River Region (URR) to support his re-election bid in December, promising to construct 360 kilometers of roads in the region if he secures another term in office. Speaking at the inauguration of the Basse–...
items.author: Makutu Manneh
